_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Agents may ONLY use facts written in this file. Anything null/empty = do not answer; skip the job and log 'Needs Review'. Fill every FILL_ME with TRUE facts about YOU. Never exaggerate.
name: FILL_ME Full Legal Name

work_rights.statement: FILL_ME one honest sentence, e.g. 'Australian citizen' or '<visa type>: <your hours rule and any dates it changes>'
never_claim: FILL_ME things you must NEVER claim, e.g. 'Australian citizen', 'permanent resident', 'unrestricted work rights'

availability.statement: FILL_ME exactly what to state on every resume, cover letter and form, e.g. 'Available Monday to Sunday, any shift' or list the days/times you are NOT available.

experience.title: FILL_ME job title
verified_duties: FILL_ME one TRUE duty per line (agents turn these into resume bullets)

certificates: FILL_ME only certificates/licences you really hold, e.g. First Aid, RSA, full driver's licence, WWCC
systems: FILL_ME e.g. Microsoft Excel, POS systems
skills_verified: FILL_ME skills you can prove, one per line
not_held: FILL_ME things you do NOT have, so agents skip jobs needing them (e.g. forklift licence, Cert III in Individual Support, truck licence, 2+ years in a field)
checks_held: FILL_ME e.g. National Police Check (issued month year), Working with Children Check
career_summary: FILL_ME 2-4 true sentences for the top of the resume.
cover_experience_paragraph: FILL_ME one true paragraph for cover letters summarising your experience.
cover_strength_bullets: FILL_ME 2-3 true one-line strengths for cover letters

keyword_skills.line: EXAMPLE: replace this line with a true skill line you can back up (lines starting with EXAMPLE are never used)

form_answers.pay_expectation: Use the rate advertised. If none: 'Award rate, open to discussion'.
form_answers.right_to_work_question: FILL_ME which option to pick on portals, or 'SKIP and flag' if none fits
form_answers.transport: FILL_ME e.g. Personal car (full licence) / public transport
form_answers.aboriginal_or_tsi: NOT APPROVED to answer. Leave blank; if mandatory, skip the job and log Needs Review.

always_skip_if: requires citizen or permanent resident (if that is not you)
requires a qualification or licence listed in not_held
asks for a fee, bank details, TFN, ID documents, or to move to WhatsApp/Telegram
pay far above market for the role with vague duties (scam signal)
asks something not covered by form_answers (answer is null/unknown)
login wall, CAPTCHA or verification code appears

email_policy.account: FILL_ME the job email, read via Gmail in the signed-in Chrome profile only
email_policy.rule: If an employer replies and it needs your action or a decision, ASK YOU first and do not reply. If it is routine (thanks, receipt, simple facts already in this file), reply on your behalf and tell you.
ask_user_first: interview invitations or any time/date to accept or propose
job offers, pay, contract, start date or roster decisions
requests for documents, ID, passport, visa details, bank details, TFN, police check upload
assessments, tests, video interviews, forms or links to complete
anything unclear, negative, or that looks like a scam (flag as SCAM, do not reply)
email_policy.style: Short, polite. Sign off with your name and phone. Never include sensitive data (ID numbers, bank, TFN, passport, full date of birth).

browser_rule.allowed: Claude in Chrome connected to the Chrome profile signed in as FILL_ME your-job-email@example.com ONLY.
browser_rule.verify_before_work: At the start of every session open https://myaccount.google.com/ in your own tab and confirm that account. If it shows another account, or portals are signed out, STOP and tell the user.
